name: Switch-position function qualifier
summary: This qualifier marks the publisher's switch-position function element.
description: This qualifier marks the publisher's switch-position function element. A position-function element contributes to the meaning of a compound switching representation. It is interpreted with the device boundary and contacts, not as a free-standing circuit element.
Preserve position labels and normal-state conventions when the compound symbol is expanded into several schematic contacts. Device tagging ties those views together.
readingNotes: Read position and switching action with the complete device symbol.
A function qualifier is an element of a compound symbol rather than a complete device record.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Read position and switching action with the complete device symbol.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A function qualifier is an element of a compound symbol rather than a complete device record.
